input_fields.name: parameter_name
input_fields.description: The case-neutral name for one parameter.

input_fields.name: source_dimension
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `value`, `unit`, `provenance`, and `source_ref`; value is one supplied parameter value and provenance identifies its source kind.

input_fields.name: unit_and_allowed_range
input_fields.description: Object with required key `unit`; optional keys `lower`, `upper`, and `allowed_values` declare one range without evaluating whether the value satisfies it.

input_fields.name: existing_parameter_names
input_fields.description: Names already declared in the same build contract, used only for conflict detection.

result_fields.name: parameter_declaration
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `name`, `value`, `unit`, `allowed_range`, and `provenance`; nullable when the common output envelope records an unresolved declaration.

procedure: Normalize the supplied name, value, unit, range representation, and provenance without adding a default value or evaluating the range constraint.
Check the name against existing declarations and check only name, source value, unit, and range representation coherence.
Construct one parameter declaration containing name, value, unit, allowed range, and provenance; leave constraint satisfaction to MS-02.
Return `parameter_declaration` as action data and place status, provenance ownership, and any unresolved fields in the common output envelope.
rejection_rules: Reject a missing, ambiguous, or conflicting parameter name.
Reject a value with unknown dimensionality, incompatible units, or a malformed range representation; do not infer a value or decide whether it satisfies the range.
Do not bundle multiple parameters or a construction recipe into one declaration.
